messages.content: What is the difference between a Subsystem and a Resource in Urho3D?

Subsystems are engine singletons — one of each, created at startup, accessed with GetSubsystem<T>():
- ResourceCache (loads files)
- Input (keyboard/mouse)
- UI (interface system)
- Graphics (rendering)
- Renderer (viewports/passes)
- Audio (sound playback)
- Network (connections)
- FileSystem (file I/O)
- Log (logging)

Resources are data files loaded through ResourceCache:
- Model (3D mesh)
- Material (surface properties)
- Texture2D (image)
- Font (text rendering)
- Sound (audio clip)
- Animation (skeletal anim)
- XMLFile (XML data)

NEVER GetSubsystem<Font>() — Font is a resource, not a subsystem.
NEVER GetSubsystem<Model>() — Model is a resource.
ALWAYS cache->GetResource<Font>(path) to load resources.
List all the Urho3D light type enum constants.

LIGHT_DIRECTIONAL — parallel rays, like the sun. No position, only direction.
LIGHT_POINT — radiates in all directions from a point. Has position and range.
LIGHT_SPOT — cone of light. Has position, direction, range, and cutoff angle.

Usage:
```cpp
light->SetLightType(LIGHT_DIRECTIONAL);
light->SetLightType(LIGHT_POINT);
light->SetLightType(LIGHT_SPOT);
```

NOT LightType::Directional, NOT LightType::Point, NOT LightType::Spot.
Urho3D uses plain constants, not scoped enums.
List the Urho3D blend mode enum constants.

BLEND_REPLACE — no blending, overwrite
BLEND_ADD — additive (src + dst)
BLEND_MULTIPLY — multiply (src * dst)
BLEND_ALPHA — standard alpha blending
BLEND_ADDALPHA — additive with alpha
BLEND_PREMULALPHA — premultiplied alpha
BLEND_INVDESTALPHA — inverse destination alpha
BLEND_SUBTRACT — subtractive
BLEND_SUBTRACTALPHA — subtractive with alpha

Usage:
```cpp
graphics->SetBlendMode(BLEND_ALPHA);
```

NOT BlendMode::Alpha. Plain constants.
List the Urho3D compare mode enum constants.

CMP_ALWAYS — always pass
CMP_EQUAL — pass if equal
CMP_NOTEQUAL — pass if not equal
CMP_LESS — pass if less
CMP_LESSEQUAL — pass if less or equal
CMP_GREATER — pass if greater
CMP_GREATEREQUAL — pass if greater or equal
CMP_NEVER — never pass

Usage:
```cpp
graphics->SetDepthTest(CMP_LESSEQUAL);
```

NOT CompareMode::LessEqual. Plain constants.
List the Urho3D cull mode enum constants.

CULL_NONE — no face culling
CULL_CCW — cull counter-clockwise faces (Urho3D default)
CULL_CW — cull clockwise faces

Usage:
```cpp
graphics->SetCullMode(CULL_CCW);
```

NOT CullMode::CCW. Plain constants.
What are the Urho3D horizontal alignment constants?

HA_LEFT — align to left edge
HA_CENTER — center horizontally
HA_RIGHT — align to right edge
HA_CUSTOM — custom position

Usage:
```cpp
text->SetHorizontalAlignment(HA_CENTER);
button->SetHorizontalAlignment(HA_RIGHT);
```

NOT HorizontalAlignment::Center. Plain constants.
What are the Urho3D vertical alignment constants?

VA_TOP — align to top
VA_CENTER — center vertically
VA_BOTTOM — align to bottom
VA_CUSTOM — custom position

Usage:
```cpp
text->SetVerticalAlignment(VA_TOP);
button->SetVerticalAlignment(VA_CENTER);
```

NOT VerticalAlignment::Top. Plain constants.
What are the texture unit enum constants?

TU_DIFFUSE — base color texture (slot 0)
TU_NORMAL — normal map (slot 1)
TU_SPECULAR — specular map (slot 2)
TU_EMISSIVE — emissive/glow map (slot 3)
TU_ENVIRONMENT — environment/reflection map (slot 4)

Usage:
```cpp
material->SetTexture(TU_DIFFUSE, cache->GetResource<Texture2D>("Textures/Stone.png"));
material->SetTexture(TU_NORMAL, cache->GetResource<Texture2D>("Textures/Stone_Normal.png"));
```

NOT TextureUnit::Diffuse. Plain constants.
